title: Smart Data Models - FIBO - LegalEntityIdentifierRegistryEntry
description: entry in a legal entity identifier registry that conforms to ISO 17442 and the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF) Common Data Format (CDF) (FIBO Production 2026Q3 class fibo-fbc-fct-breg:LegalEntityIdentifierRegistryEntry, 'legal entity identifier registry entry'. Attributes derived from the OWL restrictions on this class and its superclasses fibo-fbc-fct-breg:BusinessRegistryEntry, cmns-ra:RegistryEntry, cmns-col:Constituent; FIBO property names verbatim.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'LegalEntityIdentifierRegistryEntry'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

comprises.description: Property. Model:'https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Collections/comprises'. includes, consists of, or contains, especially within a particular scope. Here: the legal entity identifier (identifierClass fibo-be-le-lei:LegalEntityIdentifier, hasTag = the LEI, identifies = the LegalEntity). FIBO restriction: fibo-fbc-fct-breg:LegalEntityIdentifierRegistryEntry some fibo-be-le-lei:LegalEntityIdentifier; fibo-fbc-fct-breg:BusinessRegistryEntry some fibo-be-le-cb:RegistrationIdentifier; cmns-ra:RegistryEntry min 0 cmns-ra:RegisteredIdentifier.

hasRegistrationStatus.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/BusinessRegistries/hasRegistrationStatus'. indicates the status of a specific registration, such as for an identifier or license. Values: FIBO individuals of fibo-fbc-fct-breg:RegistrationStatus as compact IRIs: fibo-fbc-fct-breg:AnnulledStatus (annulled status, GLEIF code ANNULLED); fibo-fbc-fct-breg:CancelledStatus (cancelled status, GLEIF code CANCELLED); fibo-fbc-fct-breg:DuplicateStatus (duplicate status, GLEIF code DUPLICATE); fibo-fbc-fct-breg:IssuedStatus (issued status, GLEIF code ISSUED); fibo-fbc-fct-breg:LapsedStatus (lapsed status, GLEIF code LAPSED); fibo-fbc-fct-breg:MergedStatus (merged status, GLEIF code MERGED); fibo-fbc-fct-breg:PendingArchivalStatus (pending archival status, GLEIF code PENDING_ARCHIVAL); fibo-fbc-fct-breg:PendingTransferStatus (pending transfer status, GLEIF code PENDING_TRANSFER); fibo-fbc-fct-breg:PendingValidationStatus (pending validation status, GLEIF code PENDING_VALIDATION); fibo-fbc-fct-breg:RetiredStatus (retired status, GLEIF code RETIRED); fibo-fbc-fct-breg:TransferredStatus (transferred status, GLEIF code TRANSFERRED). FIBO restriction: fibo-fbc-fct-breg:LegalEntityIdentifierRegistryEntry some fibo-fbc-fct-breg:RegistrationStatus; fibo-fbc-fct-breg:BusinessRegistryEntry max 1 fibo-fbc-fct-breg:RegistrationStatus.

hasInitialRegistrationDate.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/BusinessRegistries/hasInitialRegistrationDate'. indicates the date on which an identifier or other registered item was created and/or first registered. GLEIF CDF InitialRegistrationDate. FIBO restriction on cmns-ra:hasRegistrationDate, of which this is a FIBO sub-property: fibo-fbc-fct-breg:BusinessRegistryEntry some cmns-dt:CombinedDateTime.

hasRegistrationRevisionDate.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/BusinessRegistries/hasRegistrationRevisionDate'. indicates the date that the status of a specific registration in the registry was revised. GLEIF CDF LastUpdateDate. FIBO restriction on cmns-ra:hasRegistrationDate, of which this is a FIBO sub-property: fibo-fbc-fct-breg:BusinessRegistryEntry some cmns-dt:CombinedDateTime.

hasRenewalDate.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/BusinessRegistries/hasRenewalDate'. indicates the date by which a specific registration in the registry must be renewed or updated. GLEIF CDF NextRenewalDate. FIBO restriction on cmns-ra:hasRegistrationDate, of which this is a FIBO sub-property: fibo-fbc-fct-breg:BusinessRegistryEntry some cmns-dt:CombinedDateTime.

hasValidationDate.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/BusinessRegistries/hasValidationDate'. indicates the date that a specific registration in the registry was most recently reviewed and validated. FIBO restriction on cmns-ra:hasRegistrationDate, of which this is a FIBO sub-property: fibo-fbc-fct-breg:BusinessRegistryEntry some cmns-dt:CombinedDateTime.

hasValidationLevel.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/BusinessRegistries/hasValidationLevel'. indicates the level of validation performed by the registrar with respect to the legal entity. Values: FIBO individuals of fibo-fbc-fct-breg:EntityValidationLevel as compact IRIs: fibo-fbc-fct-breg:EntityValidationLevelEntitySuppliedOnly (entity validation level - entity-supplied only, GLEIF code ENTITY_SUPPLIED_ONLY); fibo-fbc-fct-breg:EntityValidationLevelFullyCorroborated (entity validation level - fully corroborated, GLEIF code FULLY_CORROBORATED); fibo-fbc-fct-breg:EntityValidationLevelPartiallyCorroborated (entity validation level - partially corroborated, GLEIF code PARTIALLY_CORROBORATED). GLEIF CDF ValidationSources. FIBO restriction: fibo-fbc-fct-breg:LegalEntityIdentifierRegistryEntry some fibo-fbc-fct-breg:EntityValidationLevel.

hasValidationAuthority.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/BusinessRegistries/hasValidationAuthority'. identifies the business registration authority for the legal entity, used by the Local Operating Unit (LOU) as the basis for validation, as defined in the GLEIF Registration Authorities List. Here: GLEIF Registration Authorities List codes (CDF ValidationAuthorityID), e.g. RA000304. FIBO restriction: fibo-fbc-fct-breg:LegalEntityIdentifierRegistryEntry min 0 fibo-fbc-fct-breg:BusinessRegistrationAuthority.

hasManagingLocalOperatingUnit.description: Property. Model:'https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/BusinessRegistries/hasManagingLocalOperatingUnit'. relates a legal entity identification record to the identifier for the local operating unit that registered the relevant legal entity identifier. Here: the LEI of the managing LOU (GLEIF CDF ManagingLOU), as an Identifier. FIBO restriction: fibo-fbc-fct-breg:LegalEntityIdentifierRegistryEntry only fibo-be-le-lei:LegalEntityIdentifier.

Identifier.description: FIBO / OMG Commons identifier (cmns-id:Identifier and its subclasses), nested. FIBO pattern: the identifier is an individual of its class whose code is given by cmns-dsg:hasTag and which cmns-id:identifies the thing.

identifierClass.description: Not a FIBO term (Smart Data Models addition, stands for rdf:type): the FIBO/Commons class of the identifier: fibo-be-le-lei:LegalEntityIdentifier (legal entity identifier); fibo-be-le-cb:RegistrationIdentifier (registration identifier); fibo-fbc-fct-breg:BusinessRegisterIdentifier (business register identifier); fibo-fbc-fct-fse:BusinessIdentifierCode (business identifier code); fibo-be-le-fbo:ValueAddedTaxIdentificationNumber (value-added tax identification number); fibo-fnd-pty-pty:TaxIdentifier (tax identifier); fibo-sec-sec-id:InternationalSecuritiesIdentificationNumber (international securities identification number); fibo-fbc-fi-fi:FinancialInstrumentIdentifier (financial instrument identifier); fibo-fbc-pas-caa:AccountIdentifier (account identifier); cmns-id:Identifier (identifier).

hasTag.description: Model:'https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Designators/hasTag'. associates unique combination of alphanumeric characters corresponding to a designator for something Here: the identifier code itself (e.g. the 20-character LEI, the ISIN, the register number).

isRegisteredIn.description: Model:'https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/RegistrationAuthorities/isRegisteredIn'. indicates the registry that something is registered in Here: the registry, given by its GLEIF Registration Authorities List code (e.g. RA000304) or name.

identifies.description: Model:'https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Identifiers/identifies'. recognizes or establishes identity within some context Here: the NGSI-LD id of the identified entity, when it is in the same system.
